entries.en: to meet by chance; to happen upon

entries.zh: 绊着、踢着而碰上；踉跄中遇着
entries.en: to come upon while stumbling; to stumble on
entries.notes: 汉栏第二字存疑（踢/踶），西语 tropezando 义为绊跌，故释为「绊碰而遇」。

entries.en: to run into; to collide head-on with
entries.notes: 汉栏第二字存疑（槐/槌），西语 dar en contron 指迎面撞击，故释为「撞上」。

entries.en: to meet each other; to encounter
to conceal; to keep quiet about
entries.notes: 汉栏字形存疑（瞞/賄），M 栏三音节与 R 栏单音节 moân 不合，依 encubrir-callar 取「瞞（隐瞒）」。

entries.en: to harbor; to conceal (stolen goods)
entries.notes: 西语 hustiado 当为 hurtado（偷来的）之讹写，汉栏字疑（窝/富），取「窝藏」义。

entries.en: to cover up; to gloss over (bad habits)
entries.notes: 汉栏作「避」（迴避），与西语 encubrir（掩盖）语义有偏移，R 栏 gŷ 亦不合，暂按「掩饰恶习」处理。

entries.en: to hide and keep silent about; to cover up
to conceal and keep (them) for oneself
entries.notes: 汉栏「軀帶」费解（字疑 軀/趣），四栏无法互证，仅依西语义推。

entries.zh: 与众人一同藏匿；对所有人隐瞒
entries.en: to hide along with them; to conceal oneself from everyone
entries.notes: 汉栏「趣帶」与西语「encubrirse de todos」不能对合，M/R 与上条全同，疑原稿重出。

entries.en: to cover up in words; to conceal verbally
entries.notes: 汉栏「趣聞」（字疑 聞/開）与 encubrir de palabra 不合，M 栏 ā chà 亦无对应，释义存疑。

entries.en: to harbor thieves
to harbor thieves
to screen; to cover (the face)
to keep silent about out of taboo; to gloss over (faults)
to conceal; to hide (faults)
to cover up; to hush up

entries.zh: 隐匿（他人的功绩与伟大）
entries.en: to conceal; to hide (others' merits and greatness)
entries.notes: 西语后半句残缺（otros y la enga ñe），R 栏 xìn mī 与「匿」音不合，仅前半可定。

entries.en: to harbor stolen goods; to act as receiver (fence)
entries.notes: L 栏 hustiado=hurtado（偷来的）为推断，末语 por el ca/dho mino 残缺难解，依汉栏「窝家」定收赃义。

entries.en: crossroads; crossroad
entries.notes: L 栏 OCR 作 Enorucijada，按字母序及 H/R 栏（橫路 hêng lū）还原为 Encrucijada de caminos。
